name: Random Rings
description: Irregular overlapping rings in a mixed ink palette, each with a random size and roundness, slowly blurring and scaling up on hover.

code.style: --rule: ( @place-cell: center; @size: @r(100%); border-radius: @r(30%, 50%); border: 1px solid @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; grid-gap: -1px; overflow:hidden; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
